description: Synthesis of Adaptation Options for Coastal Areas is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA Climate Ready Estuaries Program. Coastal managers can consult this guide to help them understand adaptation options that are relevant to estuarine management goals. Theguide provides a brief introduction to key physical impacts of climate change on estuaries and a review of on-the-ground adaptation options that can reduce their systems’ vulnerability to climate change impacts. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Water Quality. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
